s1.syndrome_frame: Asymptomatic eruptive facial lesion in a patient with hematologic malignancy
salient_findings: Atypical dermal infiltrate of monocytoid-appearing cells
Identical pathogenic variations in ASXL1, IDH2, and STAG2 genes in bone marrow and skin biopsy specimens
key_facts: 3×2–mm smooth, red, dome-shaped papule under the right lower eyelid
Diffuse atypical dermal infiltrate of monocytoid-appearing cells
Hypercellular bone marrow with atypical erythropoiesis
10% to 15% myeloblasts in bone marrow biopsy specimens
Identical pathogenic variations in ASXL1, IDH2, and STAG2 genes in bone marrow and skin biopsy specimens

shortlist.label: Langerhans Cell Histiocytosis
shortlist.why_kept: Uniformly positive for CD207/langerin and presence of atypical diffuse dermal infiltrate of monocytoid-appearing cells

shortlist.label: Myeloid Sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of chronic high-grade myelodysplastic syndrome and refractory anemia with excess blasts, with identical pathogenic variations in ASXL1, IDH2, and STAG2 genes in bone marrow and skin biopsy specimens

shortlist.label: Langerhans Cell Sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Similar clinical presentation to Langerhans Cell Histiocytosis, but with more aggressive features and potential for leukemic presentation

shortlist.label: Myeloid Leukemia Cutis
shortlist.why_kept: Cutaneous involvement in a patient with hematologic malignancy, with presence of myeloblasts in bone marrow biopsy specimens

shortlist.label: Blastic Plasmacytoid Dendritic Cell Neoplasm
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of atypical monocytoid-appearing cells and identical pathogenic variations in ASXL1, IDH2, and STAG2 genes in bone marrow and skin biopsy specimens

raw.rationale: The patient's skin biopsy showed a diffuse atypical dermal infiltrate of monocytoid-appearing cells that were uniformly positive for CD207/langerin, which is a specific marker for Langerhans cells, and the presence of the BRAF-V600E variant is also consistent with Langerhans Cell Histiocytosis.

rejected.label: Myeloid Sarcoma
rejected.why: The cells were negative for myeloperoxidase, which is a marker for myeloid cells.

rejected.label: Langerhans Cell Sarcoma
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and biopsy findings are more consistent with Langerhans Cell Histiocytosis than the rare and aggressive Langerhans Cell Sarcoma.

rejected.label: Myeloid Leukemia Cutis
rejected.why: The immunohistochemical profile does not support a myeloid leukemia cutis diagnosis.

rejected.label: Blastic Plasmacytoid Dendritic Cell Neoplasm
rejected.why: The specific expression of CD207/langerin points towards Langerhans Cell Histiocytosis rather than a blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.
